title: SDSS9 color
credit: Sloan Digital Sky Survey; color HiPS CDS/P/SDSS9/color by T. Boch (CDS), cut out by the CDS hips2fits service

geometryEvidence.reference: Leroy et al. (2021), PHANGS-ALMA, ApJS 257, 43, table of galaxies (orientations from Lang et al. 2020), row NGC1068: inclination 34.7 ± 5.0°, position angle 72.7 ± 10.0°. Which edge of the disc is nearer is not in the source: the disc is drawn with the edge at position angle 163° nearer, an assumption.

displayModel: The photograph lies on one flat plane, the disc's midplane, as the Milky Way's backing image does. Nothing in the image has depth.
coverage: Stars are removed from the picture before the bake by NOX, which predicts the light under a star and does not measure it; 4 of the 4 Gaia stars brighter than G 14 in the picture had a glow, filled out to at most 161 px (31″).

acquisition.operation: Request the cutout from the CDS hips2fits service: 3000 x 3000 px, 0.163 degrees wide, tangent projection on 40.669729, -0.013278, north up; no crop or resample.
